unit_label: BRBL C U06: Select measures and management powers within their statutory boundaries

facts.statement: Measures include possession, qualified takeover of business management, manager and specified third-party payment direction. Substantial-business/severability provisos attach to13(4)(b), not general13(4)(a). Balance recovery, guarantor/pledge routes and ordinary-course transfer exception are distinct.

facts.locator: printed pp.269-279 / PDF pp.288-298, whole unit and end questions visually inspected
facts.statement: Courseware outlines enforcement; older redemption wording and placement of management restrictions reconciled against amended primary text rather than repeated.

payload.title: Identify which power carries which restriction
payload.core_explanation_md:
Section 13(4) separates possession of secured assets, the qualified takeover of business management, appointing a manager and directing the specified third-party payments. The substantial-business and severability provisos belong to the management-takeover clause 13(4)(b). Moving them into the ordinary possession clause changes the legal test.

Section 13 also distinguishes recovery of a balance after realisation and the separate guarantor/pledge routes. After the demand notice, the restriction on transferring the identified secured assets includes an ordinary-course-of-business exception and otherwise requires prior written creditor consent. Neither possession nor default should be presented as automatic creditor ownership of every borrower property. Detailed sale-rule compliance remains a separate step.

self_check.prompt_text: Should the management-takeover provisos be mechanically applied as the wording of every possession measure?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Attach each proviso to the clause it qualifies.

payload.stem_md: A checklist moves the substantial-business and severability provisos from section13(4)(b) into every use of section13(4)(a). What should the editor do?

options.text_md: Restore the provisos to the management-takeover clause they qualify
options.explanation_md: Clause placement matters to the scope of the legal condition.

options.text_md: Delete every proviso because possession is mentioned elsewhere
options.explanation_md: Relevant management restrictions cannot simply be removed.

options.text_md: Replace them with a universal borrower-ownership transfer rule
options.explanation_md: Taking a measure does not automatically transfer all borrower property to the creditor.

options.text_md: Use the same wording for guarantor recovery without examining its route
options.explanation_md: Separate routes need their own applicable conditions.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Clause placement matters to the scope of the legal condition.

payload.stem_md: After a demand notice, a business proposes a transaction involving an identified secured asset. Which section13(13) distinction must be examined?

options.text_md: Every transaction is automatically permitted once the asset is valued
options.explanation_md: Valuation does not establish compliance with the transfer restriction.

options.text_md: No business transaction can ever fall within an exception
options.explanation_md: The text contains an ordinary-course exception.

options.text_md: Whether it is in the ordinary course and, otherwise, whether prior written consent exists
options.explanation_md: The statutory restriction is qualified, rather than an absolute label.

options.text_md: An oral internal approval always equals creditor written consent
options.explanation_md: The required consent cannot be assumed from an internal oral decision.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The statutory restriction is qualified, rather than an absolute label.
